svg.title: Alumina Refinery
svg.text: Each item stands for the train it belongs to: one settler and one washer for a six-stage decantation circuit.
TH-901 and TH-902 are drawn with the ISO 10628-2 item 28.4 C2021 cross-beam on the rake shaft. The drive above it is not drawn: it is a tagged item of its own.
Lime burning, causticisation, oxalate removal, residue disposal and product cooling are not in this set of drawings.
